The '''Seswenna Defense Forces''' was the [[Planetary Security Forces|Planetary Security Force]] for the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin]] served in the Defense Forces and in [[66 BBY/Legends|66 BBY]], he led a successful campaign against the [[Delmaasi pirates/Legends|Delmaasi pirates]]. In [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]], Tarkin was appointed as the Seswenna [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]], which gave him command of the Defense Forces. He set about expanding the Defense Forces' capabilities, and under Tarkin's guidance it eventually became part of the larger [[Outland Regions Security Force/Legends|Republic Outland Regions Security Force]].
